messages:
incident-bot: @channel Heads-up: Elevated 429s and truncated streaming responses observed in Hosted API (eu-central-1) starting ~10:17 UTC. We're classifying as P2. Public status: status.redwood.ai/incidents/1796009876 :warning:

ops-oncall: Noticing a steady rise in 429s on /v1/chat/stream. Error pattern differs from simple rate spikes - sessions remain open longer than expected, leading to session-count exhaustion on the edge.

dev-reliability: Correlating metrics: edge concurrent sessions peaked at 38k (baseline 6k). Backend tokens still okay but many streams abruptly close with a 499/timeout on client side.

rachel: Workaround plan: enable connection reaper with aggressive idle timeout (15s) on F/E proxies to reclaim stuck sessions. Patching and canarying now.

sam: Support: Received ~7 customer reports, mostly mid-sized SaaS customers in EU. CS drafting proactive note.

deploy-bot: deployment started by rachel:proxy/reaper-0.9 -> canary (eu-central-1) at 10:29 UTC

dev-reliability: Canary shows concurrent sessions decline ~80% within 2m of reaper enabling. Stream truncations falling too. Proceeding staged rollout with 5m waves.

ops-oncall: Also adding temporary per-client session cap of 12 and a soft 429 override for internal trusted keys to avoid hitting paying customers where possible. Rule id: eu-central-temp-cap-2026-03.

rachel: Note: this is a safe reaper; it only terminates sessions idle >15s that have not sent token progress in that window. Should not affect normal long-poll clients.

cs-team: Posted customer-facing update: "We are mitigating streaming interruptions in eu-central-1. If you see truncated streams, please retry; engineering is rolling a fix." Link: intranet.redwood.ai/cs/1796009876-update

dev-reliability: Added a WAF fingerprint for noisy client cluster (203.0.113.0/25) after finding abnormal reconnection patterns. Blocking at edge cut noisy traffic by ~60%.

ops-oncall: Rollout complete at 10:51 UTC. Metrics: 429 rate back to baseline (0.9% -> 0.5%), open sessions back to ~7k steady. Keeping reaper and caps in place for 45m monitoring window.

dev-reliability: Quick snippet from proxy logs for triage: 
```
[10:18:43] WARN  proxy: session_stale client=203.0.113.45 idle_ms=920013 streams_open=24
[10:19:01] ERROR stream_mux: client=203.0.113.45 reconnect_rate=220/s cause=abandoned_handshake
```

ops-oncall: Current status: mitigated -> monitoring. We'll publish a concise incident summary and RCA within 72 hours. Internal RCA draft will be at intranet.redwood.ai/incidents/1796009876-rca

sam: CS will send tailored notes to the 7 affected customers and offer support credits where appropriate.

dev-reliability: Action items created: IR-1796009876-1 (improve client heartbeat detection), IR-1796009876-2 (edge quota enforcement enhancements), IR-1796009876-3 (add anomaly alert for session-growth velocity). Owners assigned.

incident-bot: Status updated: mitigated -> monitoring. Public page: status.redwood.ai/incidents/1796009876 (internal draft: intranet.redwood.ai/incidents/1796009876)

ops-oncall: Closing active ops thread. If any regression, reopen or ping me directly. :thumbsup:
